overview: A row of buttons on every chest, sort, dump, restock, take all, and sixteen colours of paint for a chest that is already standing.

1.1.0: Shulker boxes get the same row of buttons as a chest, so one can be sorted, filled and emptied where it stands. A box with no room to swing its lid still refuses to open, and the piglins still take it personally.
1.0.1: A chest can be shared with somebody by command, and a take-all stops at the end of your pack instead of running on into armour, offhand and the slots no screen shows.
A vanilla client keeps vanilla's chest, and a server can set aside places where nothing is to be locked.
1.0.0: Sort, deposit, restock, take all and top up, on chests, barrels, chest minecarts and chest boats, with a sort button in your own inventory as well. Sorting fills the hotbar rather than tidying it, since a hotbar is a set of controls, and you can lock it.
Sixteen dyes paint a chest already placed, with no recipe, no new item and no emptying it first. The paint comes back off when the chest is broken.
